newsitem.title: USA: Tyco says note tender condtion satisfied.
newsitem.headline: Tyco says note tender condtion satisfied.

text.p: Tyco International Ltd said on Tuesday that the minimum tender condition for its 9-1/2 percent debentures and its 8-1/8 percent notes has been satisfied.
Tenders may no longer be withdrawn, the company said in a statement.
The tender offers are currently scheduled to expire at 1200 EDT, July 2, 1997, unless otherwise extended or terminated.
J.P. Morgan Securities Inc is acting as dealer manager in connection with the tender offers and is providing certain financial advisory services to Tyco.
